data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded material adverse prior-year reserve development in 2020, driven principally by adverse development in certain financial/professional lines, partially offset by favourable development across other classes. Using the published gross claims development triangle (no explicit gross prior-year movement note was provided), the aggregate gross prior-year strengthening is calculated at approximately GBP 118.7m (about 9.5% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,250.1m). The syndicate noted COVID-19 had limited direct claims impact to date but affected investment returns and operations; Lloyd's Brexit transfers also occurred during the year.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was located in the notes; gross prior-year development was derived using the published gross claims development triangle (note 16). The triangle may be influenced by reinsurance to close and other adjustments; this extraction excludes the '2010 and prior' aggregate column per instructions. The large movement in the 2018 column may reflect case-specific items or reinsurance/reallocation effects; therefore the computed aggregate prior-year strengthening (GBP 118.7m) should be treated as an estimate derived from the triangle rather than an explicitly stated gross movement.
